Fix refresh admission race and stale-run session clearing (S4 R4 reimplementation)

Reimplements the unpreserved R4 delta on top of the accepted R3
body-timeout/loader repairs, from the archived R3 audit A/B findings.

S4-R3-A-01 (refresh coalescer): establish/clear used to detach ANY in-flight
refresh, including one still queued behind the transition on the state
lock. That run reads the NEW refresh token, so detaching it let a second
caller present the same refresh token in parallel (backend reuse-detection
would force a re-pair). The slot now records the epoch the run snapshotted
under, inside the lock; transitions detach only a run whose recorded epoch
is stale. Not-yet-snapshotted runs stay joinable.

S4-R3-A-02 (stale caller clears replacement): a worker run that started
under session A and hit 401 -> refresh -> null after session B had been
acknowledged used to clear B's tokens and broadcast "session expired".
The session module now exposes a session generation (bumped only by
establish/clear, never by rotation) and clearTokensIfSession(generation).
Worker runs bind to the generation they started under and re-check it
before send, retry, settle, progress and clear. Obsolete runs stop with an
honest ingest_failed ("your TGP session changed") and never touch, use or
expire the replacement session.

Preserved: shared/net.js, shared/pairing.js, scripts/browser-load-proof.mjs
(bytes unchanged). shared/log.js gains one KNOWN_EVENTS entry
(settlement_skipped_session_replaced); timeout events untouched.
shared/replay/engine.js: comment only.

Tests: test/refresh-admission-epoch.spec.js (session-level, 5 cases incl.
predecessor negative control), test/session-ownership.spec.js (real
router/worker/engine/session; stale success/reject/timeout, retry-401
after replacement, replacement without 401, plus two current-session
auth-loss negative controls).

Checkpoint commit: authored with source/static checks only (node --check);
dependency install, prettier/eslint/tsc/vitest, gates, package and browser
proof run in the granted validation slot and are reported separately.
